probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
Claim 1 (Currently amended): A __computer-implemented__ method comprising: __a processor__ determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; __the processor__ accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; __the processor__ receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; __the processor__ accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and __the processor__ making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life.

Claim 2 (Previously presented): The method of claim 1, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing step.

Claim 3 (Previously presented): The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

Claim 4 (Previously presented): The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

Claim 5 (Previously presented): The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment.

Claim 6 (Previously presented): The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction.

Claim 7 (Previously presented): The method of claim 6, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction.

Claim 8 (Previously presented): The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made via an electronic monetary transfer to an account owned by the recipient.

Claim 9 (Previously presented): The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made by sending a check to the recipient.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): A __computer-implemented__ method comprising: __a processor__ determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; __the processor__ accessing, at a first point in time, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; __the processor__ determining that the data store contains an indication that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication most recently with respect to one of said payment transactions at a second point in time earlier than the first point in time; __the processor__ comparing a time interval defined by the second and first points in time with a pre-determined permissive time interval; __the processor__ making the benefit payment, without requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time does not exceed the pre-determined permissive time interval; and __the processor__ requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, prior to making the benefit payment, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time exceeds the pre-determined permissive time interval.

Claim 11 (Previously presented): The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is seven days.

Claim 12 (Previously presented): The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is 24 hours.

Claim 13 (Previously presented): The method of claim 10, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment.

Claim 14 (Previously presented): An apparatus comprising: a processor; and a memory in communication with the processor, the memory storing program instructions, the processor operative with the program instructions to perform functions as follows: determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life.

Claim 15 (Previously presented): The apparatus of claim 14, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing.

Claim 16 (Previously presented): The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

Claim 17 (Previously presented): The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

Claim 18 (Previously presented): The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment.

Claim 19 (Previously presented): The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction.

Claim 20 (Previously presented): The apparatus of claim 19, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction.
